headline: Low interaction risk overall: no shared channels or writes are exposed, so prompt injection, leakage, and conflicts are largely blocked by default.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: Dagster has no clipboard, stdin/stdout, filesystem read/write, MCP, or browser surfaces, and spring-integration-samples likewise exposes no shared channel. With no bridge between agent_a and agent_b, prompt injection via one into the other is not plausible from the profiles alone.
conditions: IF either agent is later connected to a shared filesystem, clipboard, or MCP server, injection risk becomes plausible.
mitigations: Keep both agents isolated from shared channels.
Do not pipe one agent's output directly into the other.
requires-engineering: add provenance tagging if a bridge is introduced.

B_data_leakage.rationale: Neither profile shows filesystem access, network egress, or touched data classes, so there is no documented path for sensitive data to move from dagster to spring-integration-samples or vice versa. The pair appears local-only and unconnected in the provided profiles.
conditions: IF either agent is given shared workspace access or sensitive data classes are added, leakage risk must be re-evaluated.
mitigations: Keep sensitive files out of any shared directory.
Restrict any future shared storage to read-only where possible.

C_capability_conflict.rationale: Dagster cannot write files or modify git state, and spring-integration-samples exposes no write, git, or OAuth scopes. Without overlapping mutable capabilities, there is no capability conflict pathway between the two agents.
conditions: IF agent_b is later granted write or git permissions on the same workspace, conflict risk may emerge.
mitigations: Avoid assigning them the same mutable repository.
requires-engineering: add locking if shared writes are introduced.

D_cascading_error.rationale: No profile shows either agent consuming the other's output by default, and both are unverified docs-only entries. Any cascade would require an external orchestrator to pass outputs from dagster to spring-integration-samples, so the pathway is not default and the blast radius is limited.
conditions: IF an orchestrator feeds dagster output into spring-integration-samples without validation, cascading errors become plausible.
mitigations: Insert a validation step between agents.
Require human review before acting on generated outputs.
Log and diff intermediate outputs for quick inspection.

E_compliance.rationale: No data classes, residency constraints, certifications, or retention policies are documented for either agent, so there is no evidenced compliance mismatch to assess. Because the profiles are silent, I cannot infer a residency or regulatory conflict.
conditions: IF either profile later documents regulated data handling or residency constraints, compliance must be reassessed.
mitigations: Record residency and retention policies for both agents.
requires-engineering: add policy enforcement if regulated data is introduced.
